[2504.19336] The sequence of partial sums of a unimodular power series is not ultraflat

Mathematics > Number Theory
arXiv:2504.19336 (math)
[Submitted on 27 Apr 2025]
Title:The sequence of partial sums of a unimodular power series is not ultraflat
Authors:Tamás Erdélyi
View a PDF of the paper titled The sequence of partial sums of a unimodular power series is not ultraflat, by Tam\'as Erd\'elyi
View PDF
HTML (experimental)
Abstract:We show that if $(a_j)_{j=0}^\infty$ is a sequence of numbers $a_j \in {\Bbb C}$ with $|a_j|=1$, and $$P_n(z) = \sum_{j=0}^n{a_jz^j}\,, \qquad n=0,1,2,\ldots\,,$$ then $(P_n)$ is NOT an ultraflat sequence of unimodular polynomials. This answers a question raised by Zachary Chase.
Subjects:
Number Theory (math.NT)
MSC classes:
